description: Image Description: The image shows two mechanical keyboards placed on a wooden surface. In the foreground, there is a black full-sized keyboard with a standard QWERTY layout, featuring black keycaps and a matte finish. The keyboard has a visible brand label "FILCO" on the top right corner and includes a numeric keypad on the right side. A coiled black cable extends from the back of this keyboard, ending in a USB connector. Above this keyboard, there is a transparent plastic case
